name: Rachel
summary: Laban's younger daughter, whom Jacob loved and worked fourteen years for. She was the mother of Joseph and Benjamin, and she died giving birth to Benjamin.

key_moments.title: Meeting at the Well
key_moments.description: Rachel came to a well near Haran with her father's sheep. Jacob rolled the stone from the well, watered her flock, kissed her and wept.

key_moments.title: Seven Years Like a Few Days
key_moments.description: Jacob loved Rachel and served seven years for her, and they seemed like only a few days to him. Laban gave him Leah first, and Jacob served seven more years for Rachel.

key_moments.title: God Remembered Rachel
key_moments.description: Rachel had no children and envied her sister. Then God remembered Rachel, and she bore a son and named him Joseph.

key_moments.title: Hiding Her Father's Idols
key_moments.description: When Jacob's family left, Rachel stole her father's household idols. She hid them in the camel's saddle and sat on them while Laban searched the tent.

key_moments.title: Death on the Road
key_moments.description: On the way to Ephrath, Rachel died giving birth to her second son. She named him Benoni, Jacob called him Benjamin, and Jacob set up a pillar on her grave.
